title: Skill Frontmatter
description: Provisional schema for the YAML frontmatter at the top of each SKILL.md. Replaced in phase 5 by the one shipped inside the aiadev CLI package.

name.description: Unique skill identifier in kebab-case. Must match the containing directory name.

description.description: One-line summary used by agents to decide when to invoke the skill.

version.description: Semver. Optional during v0.1; required from v0.2.

requires.description: Other skill names, file paths, or artifacts this skill expects to exist.

handoffs.description: Skill names this skill typically invokes next. Non-binding; `implement` does not rely on handoffs to route.

disable-model-invocation.description: If true, the skill never runs the model — it is a deterministic script.

allowed-tools.description: Restrict which tools the skill may call. Optional.

license.description: Optional attribution line when the skill is adapted from another project. Primary attribution still lives in CREDITS.md.

argument-hint.description: Shown in UIs that prompt the user for arguments before invoking the skill.
